title: Check request: GET /api/open/v1/check?m=<manifest_id>&p=<base64url(proposal JSON)>
description: The query parameters as an object. p is unpadded base64url (RFC 4648 section 5) of the proposal note bytes; the decoded bytes go through exactly the intake's checks, so the check and the intake agree on every vector. p must be the canonical encoding of its bytes. Longer than 8192 characters is refused here; a decoded note over 4096 bytes is refused as oversize.
